title: BROWSER OPEN FRAMES: shift+cmd+l only (warm-idle-dark-anim-off), real HID keys, 13 presses inside the frame trace window
why: Lead 2026-11-03 (#33253): key-turn ms over every press needs each press inside debug.motion trace (about 30 s of samples); the combined sf film puts the Shift-Cmd-L presses at 22-42 s.
